title: PGx ruleset build log
description: The operational record of one attempt to build a ruleset artifact: who ran it, when it started and finished, what it produced, and any issue codes that stopped it. Everything in this file is intentionally excluded from the ruleset's semantic hash, and the schema exists partly to make that boundary explicit: a ruleset rebuilt on another machine, by another person, at another time is the same ruleset, and a document that let a wall-clock timestamp reach a content hash would make determinism untestable. A FAILED build log is a normal artifact, not an error to be edited away.

artifact_relative_path.description: Relative to the registry root. An absolute path would make the same build produce a different log on a different machine.

issue_codes.description: Empty on a build that succeeded. Codes, not prose: a build failure has to be countable and comparable across runs.
